claims.evidence: Witness report shows used tyres stacked; no readable brand/country-of-origin markings are captured, and no tyre size/model is shown.
Witness notes tread patterns and sidewall wear are visible, but tread depth/percentage is not measurable from the provided observations.
No close-up of tyre inner/outer surfaces or repair patches is described; only general tread/sidewall wear is noted.
The report mentions sidewall wear but does not confirm absence of bulges; bulges require sidewall close-ups.
No DOT date/manufacturing year or vehicle provenance is shown/readable in the witness report.

risks.risk: Tyre size/rim diameter and exact type (road/AT/HT) are unknown, which can make the tyres unusable or mismatched for the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: One clear close-up photo of the full sidewall text on at least 2 tyres showing size (e.g., width/aspect/rim) and type markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/unknown sizes and types (worst-case for buyer fit).

risks.risk: Quantity and whether tyres are a complete set (matching pairs/sets) is unknown.
risks.proof: A single wide shot showing the total number of tyres being sold, plus a count or arrangement (e.g., 4/6/8 tyres) visible in-frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an incomplete or unverified set (worst-case for matching).

risks.risk: Condition claims (90% tread, no patch, no bulge) cannot be verified; tyres may have hidden damage, repairs, or uneven wear.
risks.proof: Close-up clips/photos of: (1) tread surface, (2) both sidewalls, and (3) any repaired areas—at least one tyre per stack, taken from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used tyres with unknown tread depth and possible repairs/damage (worst-case).

risks.risk: DOT/manufacturing year (and whether tyres are old despite being 'from 2023') is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code on at least 2 tyres (date week/year visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres with unknown age (worst-case).

risks.risk: Whether wheel rims are included is unclear; tyres-only vs tyres+rims changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing what is included in the sale: tyres only, or tyres with rims—frame the rims so they are fully visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres only (worst-case if rims are not included).

proof_requests: Send clear sidewall close-ups showing tyre size and full markings (at least 2 tyres).
Send a wide shot that clearly shows the total quantity being sold and whether it’s a complete matching set.
Send close-up photos/short clips of tread and both sidewalls for at least 2 tyres, including any signs of patches, punctures, cracks, or bulges.
Send close-up photos of the DOT date code on at least 2 tyres.
Confirm whether rims are included; send a photo showing rims fully if they are.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as used car tyres, so a worst-case valuation is possible. However, key condition and provenance claims (tread %, repairs, bulges, 2023 origin) are not verifiable from the report, so pricing should assume the least favorable condition until the requested close-ups are provided.
